items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: George Pacheco (PHONETIC). He was arranged as a teacher for my brother.

ctx.x: How did your brother Ernie Royal happen to start playing trumpet?

My uncle Ernest gave him a trumpet and started him out, teaching him on the trumpet. So, my uncle Ernest was my brother Ernie's first teacher on the trumpet. After that, after he taught him all that he could teach him, he made arrangements to have a teacher that was formerly one of the solo trumpet players with Sousa's band and one of the lead trumpets with the Los Angeles Philharmonic, George Pacheco (PHONETIC). He was arranged as a teacher for my brother.
